summary: A blue bento of tiles in which each glyph tile is a pointer pad driving one parametric font control (aperture, thickness, serif, curviness, contrast), generated live by Prototypo in the browser, promoting the Prototypo app. The capture never got past the 'Loading your experience' overlay, so every instance below is reconstructed from the HTML only.

instances.look: Not visible in the capture (loader over everything). From HTML: first row is an 8/12 description tile at ~35px beside a 4/12 stack of small tiles (a 'Discover Spectral…' tile with Thickness arrows, prototypo.io URL tile, Production Type tile, share tiles); second row is a full-width tile with 'Spectral' at ~288px and a 'Try Spectral in prototypo' link
instances.ux: Left and right arrows at the edge of the big word's tile show that moving the pointer across it changes Aperture; a tooltip legend names the parameter
instances.learn: Make the name itself the first control, with arrows inside the tile saying the whole box responds

reconstruction.layout: Bootstrap-style 12-col grid of .block.box tiles on blue, with thin white or tint tile separations (inferred). Row 1 522px tall: 8/12 + 4/12 stack. Row 2 481px tall: full-width. Heights from facts; internal positions are not captured
reconstruction.typography: Description ~35px Spectral (generated font 'gfnt') white; 'Spectral' ~288px in a generated instance 'gnft-aperture'; tile labels small, in 'gr' (Spectral Regular, likely)
reconstruction.behaviour: Loader shows while 10 parametric fonts generate in the browser ('We are creating 10 parametric fonts…'). Then pointer position over .hastooltip changes the parameter, regenerating the font (inferred from the mobile helper: 'Slide your finger inside the boxes with the arrows to change the font parameters!')
reconstruction.content: Real pitch: 'Spectral, designed by our partner Production Type, is the first Google font turned parametric by Prototypo…'; share links to Facebook, Twitter, Google+, LinkedIn

instances.look: From HTML only (loader covered the capture): a bento of glyph tiles, 'S' (~576px) with three parameters, 'a' for Thickness, 'xyz' with serif height and bracket curve, 'Oo' for curviness and 'ec' at ~800px for contrast
instances.feel: A lab bench of dials with no dials
instances.ux: Each tile is its own pad. Horizontal pointer movement changes one parameter and vertical movement another (arrows along the edges mark each direction, top and bottom edges can drive different parameters); on touch, slide a finger in the box. A legend names the parameter
instances.learn: Pick the letters that show a parameter best and give each its own pad: 'S' for serifs, 'Oo' for curviness, 'ec' for contrast. The choice of glyph teaches what the axis does

reconstruction.layout: Block 02 912px tall: 4/12 'S' tile + 8/12 split into 'a' tile and a text tile. Block 03 768px tall: 4/12 stack of 'xyz' and 'Oo' + 8/12 'ec' tile. Each tile has arrow pairs on the edge of each direction and legend tooltips
reconstruction.typography: Glyphs 576–806px in generated instances (gnft-serifs, gnft-thickness, gnft-bracketcurve, gnft-curviness, gnft-contrast); legends small caps-like uppercase ('SERIF HEIGHT', 'SERIF WIDTH', 'SERIF ROTATION', 'BRACKET CURVE', 'CURVINESS', 'CONTRAST')
reconstruction.behaviour: On pointer move inside a tile the font parameter updates live, via Prototypo's browser font generator (not OpenType variations; each tile is a separate generated @font-face). 'S' tile: serif height (vertical), serif width (top horizontal), serif rotation (bottom horizontal). 'xyz': serif height (vertical), bracket curve (horizontal). Exact ranges not captured
reconstruction.content: Single letters and pairs picked per parameter

instances.look: From HTML only: a tile whose paragraph has each sentence in a different pre-generated thickness (gfnt-100, -105, -110, -70, -75…)
instances.learn: Set each sentence of the pitch in a different generated instance, so the prose shows the parameter range without a label

reconstruction.layout: 4/12-wide tile next to the 'a' tile in block 02, ~456px tall
reconstruction.typography: Spectral generated instances, one per sentence; size not captured, around 20–25px
reconstruction.content: 'Imagine shop windows that react according to the movements of passers-by. Think data visualisation mixing info and text…'
